correctness.rationale: Coarea gives intrinsic volume as the density of the weighted uniform sum at zero times the norm of the normal. Inclusion–exclusion for the truncated box gives the fourth-positive-power density formula, differentiable even at its knots on the positive orthant. Block permutation invariance forces the spherical gradient into the one-dimensional space tangent to the normalized two-level arc, so vanishing of its derivative detects full stationarity. Across all four block multiplicities the exact branch polynomials and their knot limits leave only the smaller root of 39t²−48t+13, on the (2,3) arc. This derivative changes from negative to positive there; all other arcs are strictly increasing with no zero derivative at an internal knot. The density at the root gives the claimed volume, and the orbit count is 10 choices of the two large coordinates times 16 sign patterns modulo common reversal. The path minimum does not imply an ambient minimum: splitting the two large weights to 1+a and 1−a gives a negative quadratic term at fixed t=τ. In the normalized volume its coefficient divided by √(2+3t²) is f(0)(1+1/(2+3t²))−3/(4t), where f(0)=1−13t/32 is the density for unsplit weights. This follows from convolving the trapezoidal density of the two split uniforms with the other three; the correction near the trapezoid's plateau is a² times their density at zero, 3/(4t). The first term is below 3/2 and the second is above 3/2 since t<1/2.
residual_risks: The classification does not cover zero coordinates, equal-coordinate directions, or three or more positive levels. The frozen convex-hull runs are numerical corroboration, not needed for the analytic classification.
